notes.title: Official Gameplay Trailer
notes.notes:
[p]Hey Defendrion fans! ⚔️✨[/p][p]The [b]official Gameplay Trailer[/b] for [b]Defendrion[/b] just premiered—your first deep look at the frantic, spell-slinging chaos we’ve been cooking up.[/p][p]👉 [b]Watch it now:[/b] [/p][h2]What the trailer shows off[/h2][list][*][p][b]Wave-survival mayhem[/b] across the [i]Arcane Courtyard[/i] and [i]Frostbite Keep[/i].[/p][/*][*][p][b]Evolving spell arsenal[/b]—see firebolts grow into multi-shot volleys and lightning chain across entire mobs.[/p][/*][*][p][b]On-the-fly build crafting[/b] with Power, Resilience, and Crit upgrades.[/p][/*][*][p]A glimpse of the [b]Grimstone Goliath[/b] mini-boss at Wave 10.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Controller & KB+M gameplay[/b] running at a buttery 60 FPS.[/p][/*][/list][p]If the trailer sparks your inner battlemage, [b]wishlist Defendrion[/b] on Steam and be first in line for the upcoming public demo and future updates. Your support helps us climb the charts and reach more players—thank you![/p][p]Stay tuned; more dev logs and behind-the-scenes sneak peeks are on the way.[/p][p]Best, 
Amin
